cenas.trecho: Era domingo de manhã, e a pedra do túmulo de Jesus tinha sido removida.
cenas.prompt_imagem: an ancient rock-cut tomb in a garden at dawn, a huge round stone rolled away from the open entrance, bright golden light pouring out of the empty tomb, morning mist
cenas.prompt_movimento: golden light rays pour out of the open tomb and grow brighter, morning mist drifts slowly, dust particles float in the light, camera slowly pushes in

cenas.trecho: Um anjo disse às mulheres: Ele não está aqui. Ressuscitou, como tinha dito.
cenas.prompt_imagem: a radiant angel made of white light sitting on the rolled-away stone of a tomb at dawn, three women in ancient robes and head coverings seen from behind kneeling in awe
cenas.prompt_movimento: the angel glows and its white robe flows gently, soft light pulses, the women slowly bow their heads, leaves move in the breeze

cenas.prompt_imagem: Jesus in a white robe seen from behind standing in a flowering garden at sunrise, arms slightly open, warm golden light surrounding him
cenas.prompt_movimento: his white robe and hair move gently in the breeze, the sun rises behind the hills and light spreads, flowers sway softly

cenas.trecho: E porque ele vive, você também tem esperança. Mateus vinte e oito.
cenas.prompt_imagem: a bright sunrise over green hills and an empty tomb in the distance, three empty crosses far away on a hill, golden sky, peaceful and hopeful
cenas.prompt_movimento: the sun rises and golden light spreads across the hills, clouds drift slowly, birds fly across the sky

legenda:
Ele vive, e por isso eu tenho esperança 🙏✨
Mateus 28:6
Comente "Ele vive" se você crê.
